newsitem.title: USA: Sweet U.S. domestic grades sell at firmer prices.
newsitem.headline: Sweet U.S. domestic grades sell at firmer prices.

text.p: Sluggish Monday dealings featured slightly firmer price differentials for U.S. sweet crude grades against weakening outright prices.
Traders said June grades started Monday as the prompt month in quiet fashion, reflecting market exhaustion from a turbulent May month.
"May ended messy, so a lot of people are not ready to get back in there. The barrels moving today are very spotty," said a cash trader in Houston.
Industry functions related to a Houston golf tournament and parties in Dallas were also seen muting market action.
